OUR ROOTS

A decade in Lahore.
A lifetime in the details.

Archcell is an architecture and interior design practice with ten years of experience and hundreds of projects, mainly residential. Our work begins with the everyday life a building will hold.

We think about the way a family gathers, how daylight moves through a room, and where someone might find a quiet moment. From the street-facing elevation to the final working drawing, those small decisions shape the whole.

WHAT GUIDES US

Less noise.
More meaning.

01

People before plans.

We begin with how you live: your needs, your habits, and what home means to you.

02

Context over convention.

A home belongs to its site, its climate and its neighbourhood. The design should recognise all three.

03

Every detail belongs.

Architecture, interiors and technical drawings work together as parts of one considered whole.

FROM OUTSIDE TO INSIDE

One vision.
All the way through.

A convincing elevation is only the beginning. We carry the same intention into the spaces, materials, lighting and construction details within.
